plan.notes: Source: Bluffton University registrar four-year plan PDF (bluffton.edu/registrar/images). The plan is explicitly labeled a suggested program guide, not a contract ("Changes may occur. Please see your program advisor before you register for courses."). Source: 2024InformationTechnology.pdf (updated 5/24). Credit totals per semester verified against the PDF; semester sums use the minimum of any credit ranges (Living Well Competency 2-3 resolved at 2). The PDF states "124 total hours to complete graduation requirements (this includes 2 hours of arts and lecture credit)"; the sequenced courses sum to 122, and the remaining 2 hours are arts-and-lecture attendance credit not listed as courses. No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence left empty. Degree type verified against the official Ohio Department of Higher Education Certificate of Authorization (amended April 2025): Bluffton is authorized for the Bachelor of Arts only (no standalone B.S.). Information Technology is a Bachelor of Arts major at Bluffton per the official Ohio Department of Higher Education Certificate of Authorization (amended April 2025), which authorizes no standalone Bachelor of Science (aggregators claiming a B.S. contradict the official authorization).
